items.title: Nepal-Tibet Mudslide: Over 2,000 Dead or Missing; What Does the Chinese Premier’s Visit to the Front Line Mean?
items.content_text:
English translation of captured publisher metadata: In China, disaster response often carries political signals. Especially when the General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee issues 'important instructions,' or the Premier or Vice Premier travels to the scene, it usually means that Beijing views the event as a major crisis requiring high-level attention and coordinated response.

Background / why this matters (Palimpsest synthesis, not part of the translation): The metadata states that high-level Chinese government involvement in disaster management is a political indicator of how Beijing prioritizes and manages a given crisis.

Original Chinese: 尼泊爾—西藏泥石流：逾2000人遇難或失聯，中國總理赴前線意味著什麼？ — 在中國，災難應對往往也帶有政治訊號。尤其是中共中央總書記作出「重要指示」，或總理、副總理親赴現場，通常意味著北京把事件視為需要高度關注和統籌應對的重大危機。

items.title: Shanghai Funeral Homes Restrict Catholic and Christian Funeral Rites
items.content_text:
English translation of captured publisher metadata: Starting this year, the Baoxing Funeral Home in Shanghai's Hongkou District has ceased conducting funeral ceremonies containing Catholic or Christian elements. Staff stated that the funeral home does not allow priests to attend to preside over memorial activities and will persuade families to abandon such arrangements. Shanghai's Longhua Funeral Home still permits Catholic priests to preside over memorial prayers, but requires them to be completed within one hour.

Background / why this matters (Palimpsest synthesis, not part of the translation): Radio Free Asia reports on varying degrees of restrictions regarding religious funeral services at two specific funeral homes in Shanghai.

Original Chinese: 上海殡仪馆限制天主教、基督教葬礼仪式 — 上海虹口区宝兴殡仪馆今年起停止举行带有天主教、基督教内容的治丧仪式。工作人员说，殡仪馆不允许神父到场主持追思活动，并会劝说家属放弃相关安排。上海龙华殡仪馆仍允许天主教神父主持追思祷告，但要求在一个小时内完成。

items.title: 'Secure Because It's Ancient': Why Old Technology Is Sometimes Better at Preventing Hacker Attacks?
items.content_text:
English translation of captured publisher metadata: Concerns over hacker attacks have prompted some people to turn to technologies overlooked by the new generation of cybercriminals.

Background / why this matters (Palimpsest synthesis, not part of the translation): The report explores a trend where individuals revert to older, less complex technologies as a security measure against modern cyber threats.

Original Chinese: 「因古老而安全」：為何舊技術有時更能防範黑客攻擊？ — 對黑客攻擊的擔憂，促使一些人轉而使用那些被新一代網絡罪犯忽略的技術。

items.title: New Attempt by Chinese Tech Companies: 'Sex' Robots Aim for the 'Companion Economy'
items.content_text:
English translation of captured publisher metadata: In recent years, China's 'companion economy' has emerged abruptly, and the high-speed development of AI and robotics technology has injected numerous new possibilities into this market.

Background / why this matters (Palimpsest synthesis, not part of the translation): The rapid advancement of AI and robotics is being applied to the 'companion economy' sector in China.

Original Chinese: 中國科技公司新嘗試：「性愛」機器人，瞄準「陪伴經濟」 — 近年來，中國的「陪伴經濟」異軍突起，AI和機器人技術的高速發展亦給這個市場注入諸多新的可能。

items.title: Tracing the Path of the Deadly Flash Flood in Tibet and Nepal
items.content_text:
English translation of captured publisher metadata: A catastrophic flash flood and mudslide swept through the border region between Nepal and China's Tibet, engulfing towns, destroying bridges, and causing hundreds of deaths in both areas. BBC Verify tracked the development of this deadly flash flood using verified videos and satellite imagery.

Background / why this matters (Palimpsest synthesis, not part of the translation): The report provides an investigative analysis of a natural disaster occurring in the Nepal-Tibet border region.

Original Chinese: 追溯西藏尼泊爾致命山洪如何發生 — 一場災難性山洪和泥石流席捲了尼泊爾與中國西藏交界的邊境地區，吞噬了城鎮、沖毀了橋梁，並導致兩地數百人死亡。BBC Verify利用已核實的影片和衛星圖像，追蹤這場致命山洪的發展路徑。

items.title: Trump signs executive order to rename "Lake Ontario" to "Lake America"
items.content_text:
English translation of captured publisher metadata: At the time Trump signed this executive order, US-Canada trade negotiations had been declared broken off late last week.

Background / why this matters (Palimpsest synthesis, not part of the translation): An executive order renaming Lake Ontario follows the reported collapse of US-Canada trade negotiations.

Original Chinese: 特朗普簽署行政命令，將「安大略湖」更名為「美國湖」 — 特朗普簽署這項行政命令之際，美加貿易談判已於上週稍後時間宣告破裂。

items.title: "To Me It Is Gold": How Did a Card Go From a Gaming Tool to an Asset?
items.content_text:
English translation of captured publisher metadata: Market analysis statistics suggest the global trading card game (TCG) market size is expected to rise to $12.86 billion by 2031. Why have these items, originally intended as toys for children, suddenly turned into "paper gold"?

Background / why this matters (Palimpsest synthesis, not part of the translation): Market analysis indicates that the rising economic value of trading card games is leading to their transformation into investment assets.

Original Chinese: 「在我眼中它就是黃金」：一張卡如何從遊戲工具變資產？ — 市場分析公司統計，全球集換式卡牌（TCG）市場規模到2031年有望升至128.6億美元。原本屬於小朋友的遊戲工具，何以突然變成「紙上黃金」？

items.title: U.S. military announces successful clearance of Strait of Hormuz sea mines, channel reopened
items.content_text:
English translation of captured publisher metadata: The United States Central Command (CENTCOM) announced Thursday night (August 27, Eastern Time) that U.S. forces have successfully cleared sea mines from the international shipping lane in the Strait of Hormuz and declared the channel open for navigation.

Background / why this matters (Palimpsest synthesis, not part of the translation): U.S. CENTCOM reports that the waterway is once again clear for transit following the completion of mine-clearing operations.

Original Chinese: 美军宣布成功清除霍尔木兹海峡水雷，航道恢复畅通 — 美国中央司令部(CENTCOM)美国东部时间星期四(8月27日)晚间宣布，美军已成功清除霍尔木兹海峡国际航道上的水雷，并宣布航道恢复畅通。

items.title: U.S. and Taiwan Sign Offer and Acceptance Letter for Arms Sales, Selling 2,032 Drones to Taiwan
items.content_text:
English translation of captured publisher metadata: Taiwan has taken another step forward in building drone swarm tactics for the Taiwan Strait. The U.S. and Taiwan signed a letter of offer and acceptance for an arms sale on Thursday (August 27), through which Taiwan will purchase over 2,000 attack and surveillance drone systems manufactured by the U.S. company Anduril—the Altius 700M and Altius 600 ISR.

Background / why this matters (Palimpsest synthesis, not part of the translation): The purchase is described as an effort by Taiwan to enhance its drone swarm capabilities in the Taiwan Strait.

Original Chinese: 美台签署军售发价书 售台2032架无人机 — 台湾在建构台海无人机蜂群战术上又迈进一步。美国与台湾在星期四(8月27日)签署军购发价书，台湾将购买两千多架美国安杜里尔公司制造的攻击型及监侦型无人机系统----Altius 700M以及Altius 600 ISR。

items.title: Is It Vulgar for Women to Use Profanity? Modi's Remarks Ignite Subsequent Debate on 'Cockroach BJP'
items.content_text:
English translation of captured publisher metadata: The remarks of Indian opposition MP Rahul Gandhi have again sparked a debate on gender differences, focusing on whether reactions to insults directed at Prime Minister Modi differ based on gender.

Background / why this matters (Palimpsest synthesis, not part of the translation): Public debate in India has intensified over gender-based reactions to political insults following comments made by Rahul Gandhi.

Original Chinese: 女性罵髒話很低劣嗎？莫迪言論引燃「蟑螂人民黨」後續辯論 — 印度在野黨議員拉胡爾·甘地的言論再次引發有關性別差異的辯論，焦點在於人們對辱罵總理莫迪言論的反應是否因性別而有所不同。

items.title: Hong Kong Card Craze: How Does a Card Go from a Game to an Asset and Become 'Paper Gold'?
items.content_text:
English translation of captured publisher metadata: A wave of trading card fever has swept the globe in recent years, with many people using them for investment and speculation in addition to playing games. US market analysis companies estimate that the global trading card market size reached approximately 7.8 billion USD in 2025 and is expected to rise to 12.86 billion USD by 2031. A card has turned from a game into an asset, becoming 'paper gold.' BBC Chinese breaks down the causes of the card craze and the potential for the trend to continue.

Background / why this matters (Palimpsest synthesis, not part of the translation): The metadata attributes the growing interest in trading cards to their evolving role as speculative financial assets and provides market growth projections.

Original Chinese: 香港卡牌熱潮：一張卡如何從遊戲變資產成為「紙上黃金」？ — 近年全球掀起一波集換式卡牌熱潮，除了玩樂以外，更有不少人用來投資炒賣。美國市場分析公司統計，2025年全球集換式卡牌市場規模達到約78億美元，到2031年有望升至128.6億美元。一張卡由遊戲變成資產，成為「紙上黃金」。BBC中文拆解卡牌熱潮的起因以及熱潮延續的可能性。

items.title: Peace Committee Official Criticizes Israeli Attack, Warns Alternatives Will Lead to 'Next War'
items.content_text:
English translation of captured publisher metadata: An official responsible for President Donald Trump's Gaza ceasefire plan criticized Israel on Wednesday (August 26) for launching attacks on the war-torn Palestinian territory, warning that if the U.S. proposal is not adopted, the result will be the 'next war'.

Background / why this matters (Palimpsest synthesis, not part of the translation): Voice of America Chinese reports on an official's criticism of Israeli military actions and their assertion regarding the urgency of the U.S.-led ceasefire proposal.

Original Chinese: 和平委员会官员批评以色列袭击，警告称替代方案将导致“下一场战争” — 负责唐纳德·特朗普(Donald Trump)总统加沙地带停火计划的官员星期三(8月26日)批评以色列对饱受战争蹂躏的巴勒斯坦领土发动袭击，并警告说，如果美国提案未能得到采纳，结果将是“下一场战争”。

items.title: Taiwan's Legislative Yuan passes drone budget bill; KMT says it helps build a second 'guardian mountain of the nation'; DPP government believes it fails to meet defense needs
items.content_text:
English translation of captured publisher metadata: The opposition-controlled Legislative Yuan of Taiwan passed the Kuomintang (KMT) version of the drone budget bill in its third reading on Thursday (August 27), allocating NT$40 billion annually for a total of NT$240 billion (approximately US$7.5 billion) to procure and develop unmanned vehicle capabilities. The ruling Democratic Progressive Party (DPP) government expressed regret that the Legislative Yuan failed to pass the NT$210 billion unmanned vehicle budget proposed by the Executive Yuan, but the KMT said the bill would help build Taiwan’s second 'guardian mountain of the nation' after the semiconductor industry.

Background / why this matters (Palimpsest synthesis, not part of the translation): The metadata reports on a legislative disagreement in Taiwan regarding the funding and scope of drone procurement programs.

Original Chinese: 台湾立法院通过无人机预算案 国民党称有助打造第二座“护国神山”；民进党政府认为未满足国防需求 — 由反对党控制的台湾立法院星期四(8月27日)三读通过主要反对党国民党版无人机预算案，以每年编列新台币400亿元、总金额2400亿元(约75亿美元)经费采购及建置无人载具能力。执政的民进党政府对立法院未能通过行政院提出的新台币2,100亿元无人载具预算案表达遗憾，但国民党说，此案有助打造台湾继半导体后第二座“护国神山”。

items.title: Taiwan Drone Development Faces “New Opportunity,” Supply Chain “De-Red” Progresses Steadily
items.content_text:
English translation of captured publisher metadata: Taiwan’s Legislative Yuan passed an opposition-version drone industry development plan on Thursday (August 27). Industry insiders in Taiwan state this marks a “new opportunity” for Taiwan’s unmanned vehicle industry, helping it further integrate into “non-red” supply chain markets such as Japan, the US, and Europe. Meanwhile, Taiwan continues to demonstrate its resolve to achieve a “non-red” drone supply chain by strictly vetting components in military procurement and gradually “purging red” elements from supply chains of components unrelated to information security.

Background / why this matters (Palimpsest synthesis, not part of the translation): Taiwan is pursuing legislative and supply chain changes to reduce reliance on Chinese components in its drone industry, as reported by Voice of America.

Original Chinese: 台湾无人机发展迎来“新契机”，供应链“去红”稳步推进 — 台湾立法院星期四(8月27日)通过在野党版本的无人机产业发展方案。台湾业内人士称，这标志着台湾无人载具产业迎来“新契机”，有助于台湾进一步走向日本、美国、欧洲等“非红”供应链市场。与此同时，台湾继续展示实现无人机供应链“非红”的决心：在军购中严格查验“非红”供应链，未涉资讯安全的元件的供应链也在实现逐步“排红”。

items.title: U.S. Senator Introduces Bill to Prohibit Trains Carrying U.S. Military Cargo from Using Freight Monitoring Technology Linked to the CCP
items.content_text:
English translation of captured publisher metadata: Republican Senator Joni Ernst introduced a bill on Wednesday (August 26) aimed at prohibiting railway freight monitoring technology with ties to the Chinese Communist Party from being used to track sensitive military shipments.

Background / why this matters (Palimpsest synthesis, not part of the translation): Senator Ernst is proposing legislative action to restrict the use of specific technologies in the U.S. supply chain, citing concerns regarding ties to the Chinese government and national security.

Original Chinese: 美参议员推出法案，拟禁止承担美军运输的火车使用与中共有关联的货运监控技术 — 共和党参议员乔尼·恩斯特(Joni Ernst)星期三(8月26日)推出一部法案，旨在禁止与中国共产党有关联的铁路货运监控技术被用来追踪敏感的军事运输。

items.title: As Death Toll Continues to Rise, US to Provide Aid to Nepal Flash Flood Victims
items.content_text:
English translation of captured publisher metadata: The United States says it will provide $500,000 in aid to Nepal. Previously, Nepal and Tibet were hit by devastating flash floods, which have caused at least 361 deaths and left more than 1,400 people missing, with the death toll expected to continue rising.

Background / why this matters (Palimpsest synthesis, not part of the translation): Voice of America Chinese reports on the US government's pledge of financial assistance following severe flash flooding in Nepal and Tibet.

Original Chinese: 随着死亡人数持续上升，美国将向尼泊尔山洪灾灾民提供援助 — 美国表示将向尼泊尔提供50万美元援助。此前，尼泊尔和西藏遭遇了毁灭性的山洪暴发，已造成至少361人死亡、1400多人失踪，预计死亡人数还将继续上升。

items.title: Scientists analyze the ins and outs of the deadly flash flood in Nepal-Tibet
items.content_text:
English translation of captured publisher metadata: The United States Geological Survey (USGS) stated that the cause of this disaster was a glacier collapse, but experts are still investigating how the flood developed downstream and caused severe impacts.

Background / why this matters (Palimpsest synthesis, not part of the translation): According to the USGS, a glacier collapse triggered the disaster, though the mechanism behind the downstream flooding remains under expert investigation.

Original Chinese: 科學家分析尼泊爾—西藏致命山洪的來龍去脈 — 美國地質調查局（USGS）表示，這場災難的成因是一次冰川崩塌，但專家仍在調查洪水如何在下游發展並造成嚴重影響。

items.title: Trump issues executive order banning certain foreign power grid equipment
items.content_text:
English translation of captured publisher metadata: US President Trump signed an executive order declaring a national emergency to prohibit the procurement and installation of certain foreign equipment for use in the US power grid. Although it did not name China, power grid components produced in China have raised concerns among US security officials for years.

Background / why this matters (Palimpsest synthesis, not part of the translation): The metadata cites an executive order restricting foreign power grid equipment due to reported concerns from US security officials.

Original Chinese: 特朗普颁行政令 禁部分外国电网设备 — 美国总统特朗普签署一项行政命令，宣布国家紧急状态，禁止采购和安装部分外国设备用于美国电网。虽未点名中国，但中国产电网部件多年来引发美国安全官员的忧虑。
items.external_url: https://www.dw.com/zh/特朗普颁行政令-禁部分外国电网设备/a-78524144?maca=chi-rss-chi-all-1127-rdf

items.title: Tibet Gyirong landslide disaster; county officials: comforting the families
items.content_text:
English translation of captured publisher metadata: On August 26, a massive ice and rock avalanche occurred on the Nepali side of the China-Nepal border, triggering flash floods that impacted the Gyirong Port in Gyirong County, Shigatse City, Tibet. On the morning of the 27th, Tibetan authorities announced that as of 8:00 that morning, 3 people had died, 558 were missing, and 2 people had been rescued. The missing persons include 260 foreign nationals.

Background / why this matters (Palimpsest synthesis, not part of the translation): An avalanche on the Nepal-China border led to flooding that caused fatalities and a high number of missing persons, as reported by Tibetan authorities.

Original Chinese: 西藏吉隆泥石流灾难 县府官员：正安抚家属 — 8月26日，中尼边境尼泊尔一侧发生大规模冰岩崩塌并引发山洪，西藏日喀则市吉隆县吉隆口岸受到冲击。西藏方面27日上午公布，截至当天8时，已有3人遇难、558人失联，另有2人获救。失联人员中包括260名外籍人员。

items.title: German Media: China's robots 'flexing muscles'? Don't be fooled by this tech circus
items.content_text:
English translation of captured publisher metadata: At the World Humanoid Robot Games in Beijing, robots repeatedly broke or even 'crushed' human athletic records, sparking attention. However, the Neue Zürcher Zeitung points out that this tech gala is more like a carefully designed 'circus performance.' The Süddeutsche Zeitung focuses on the US announcement of expanded sanctions against Iran, noting that Beijing's support for Iran comes with a condition: China will only remain friendly as long as Middle East conflicts do not affect its own interests.

Background / why this matters (Palimpsest synthesis, not part of the translation): The metadata cites German press analysis that questions the authenticity of Chinese robotic advancements and evaluates China's strategic stance on Iran in light of US sanctions.

Original Chinese: 德语媒体：中国机器人“秀肌肉”？别被这场科技马戏所迷惑 — 在北京举行的世界人形机器人运动会上，机器人不断刷新、甚至“碾压”人类的运动纪录，引发关注。不过，《新苏黎世报》指出，这场科技盛宴更像是一场精心设计的“马戏表演”。《南德意志报》则关注美国宣布扩大对伊朗的制裁措施，并指出，北京对伊朗的支持有一个前提：中东战事不触及自身利益，中国才会保持友善。
items.external_url: https://www.dw.com/zh/德语媒体：中国机器人-秀肌肉-？别被这场科技马戏所迷惑/a-78524275?maca=chi-rss-chi-all-1127-rdf

items.title: Japanese artist "Queen of Polka Dots" Yayoi Kusama dies at 97
items.content_text:
English translation of captured publisher metadata: She attracted a massive audience with her colorful works and achieved the highest auction prices ever for works by a female artist.

Background / why this matters (Palimpsest synthesis, not part of the translation): The metadata reports the death of Japanese artist Yayoi Kusama, highlighting her professional success and market record.

Original Chinese: 日本藝術家「波點女王」草間彌生逝世，享年97歲 — 她以色彩繽紛的作品吸引了大量觀眾，並為女性藝術家作品拍賣出有史以來最高的價格。

items.title: Artist Gao Zan Sentenced to 3 Years for Mao-Satirizing Works, Files Appeal
items.content_text:
English translation of captured publisher metadata: Chinese artist Gao Zan was sentenced to three years in prison by the Sanhe City People's Court in Hebei Province on August 25 for the crime of 'infringing on the reputation and honor of heroes and martyrs.' The case involves several works satirizing Mao Zedong, which were created between 2005 and 2009—more than a decade before the relevant criminal provisions were implemented. Gao Zan has decided to file an appeal.

Background / why this matters (Palimpsest synthesis, not part of the translation): Artist Gao Zan is appealing a three-year prison sentence imposed by a Hebei court for artworks created years before the current 'heroes and martyrs' law came into effect.

Original Chinese: 艺术家高兟因讽毛作品获刑3年提上诉 — 中国艺术家高兟8月25日被河北省三河市法院以“侵害英雄烈士名誉、荣誉罪”判处有期徒刑3年。案件涉及的多件讽刺毛泽东作品创作于2005年至2009年，早于相关刑事条款实施十多年。高兟已经决定提出上诉。

items.title: Meta Case Suddenly Settled for $18 Billion, May Accelerate Reckoning of Child Safety on Social Media
items.content_text:
English translation of captured publisher metadata: BBC Technology Editor Zoe Kleinman believes our habit of endlessly scrolling through negative information may not last much longer.

Background / why this matters (Palimpsest synthesis, not part of the translation): The entry reflects on the potential regulatory or social impacts of a major legal settlement involving Meta.

Original Chinese: Meta案突以180億美元和解，或加快清算社交媒體兒童安全 — BBC科技編輯佐伊·克萊曼（Zoe Kleinman）認為，我們無止境刷看負面資訊的習慣已時日無多。

items.title: 'My Family Was Swept Away by the Flood in Front of My Eyes': Survivor of Flash Floods at the China-Nepal Border Recounts the Ordeal
items.content_text:
English translation of captured publisher metadata: A survivor in the Nepal disaster zone told the BBC that several of her family members were swept away by floods in front of her eyes, while she and her son survived by climbing onto their roof.

Background / why this matters (Palimpsest synthesis, not part of the translation): The metadata documents a personal account from a survivor of a flash flood at the China-Nepal border, as reported by the BBC.

Original Chinese: 「家人在我眼前被洪水沖走了」：中尼邊境山洪倖存者憶述事發經過 — 有尼泊爾災區的倖存者告訴BBC，她的多名家人在自己的眼前被洪水沖走，而她和兒子因爬到屋頂上而得以生還。

items.title: 'Creating Until the Very End': Japanese Artist Yayoi Kusama Passes Away
items.content_text:
English translation of captured publisher metadata: Japanese artist Yayoi Kusama has passed away at the age of 97. Her studio released a statement on its official website on Thursday (August 27) confirming that she died at a hospital in Tokyo on August 14, 2026.

Background / why this matters (Palimpsest synthesis, not part of the translation): Deutsche Welle reports the death of artist Yayoi Kusama based on a statement released by her studio.

Original Chinese: 「直至生命盡頭仍在創作」日本藝術家草間彌生逝世 — 日本藝術家草間彌生過世，享耆壽97歲。她的工作室週四（8月27日）透過官網發布聲明證實，草間彌生於2026年8月14日在東京一間醫院逝世。
items.external_url: https://www.dw.com/zh/「直至生命盡頭仍在創作」日本藝術家草間彌生逝世/a-78519395?maca=chi-rss-chi-all-1127-rdf

items.title: These Medications Make It Harder to Cope with High Temperatures
items.content_text:
English translation of captured publisher metadata: Some of the most commonly prescribed medications, including those used to treat depression, attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD), and high blood pressure, may increase the risk of dehydration and other heat-related illnesses.

Background / why this matters (Palimpsest synthesis, not part of the translation): BBC News Chinese notes that common prescription drugs for mental health and cardiovascular conditions can inadvertently heighten health risks for patients during extreme heat.

items.title: German Media: Faced with China's Subsidy Offensive, Only a Tough Response Will Do
items.content_text:

items.content_text:

Driven by social media and recommendations from friends and family, some patients go to hospitals and request specific weight-loss medications by name.

Background / why this matters (Palimpsest synthesis, not part of the translation): Deutsche Welle reports on concerns regarding the marketing practices of weight-loss medication manufacturers in the Chinese market.

items.title: CXMT Market Cap Hits Top: Can China Rewrite the Global Technology Landscape?
items.content_text:
English translation of captured publisher metadata: After listing in Shanghai, Chinese memory giant CXMT has rapidly become the company with the highest market capitalization in China. With the explosion of the AI boom, memory has become an important strategic resource; as CXMT rises on this trend, will it shake the leading status of the U.S. and South Korea and achieve Chinese technological autonomy? DW interviewed several experts to provide analysis.

items.title: Robot Sprints Surpass Human Speed, but Deficiencies Remain Evident
items.content_text:
English translation of captured publisher metadata: On August 22, the 'World Humanoid Robot Games' opened in Beijing, where a robot ran faster than the human 100-meter world record on the same day. More than 40% of the events in this competition require robots to operate fully autonomously rather than by remote control. Although robots from various manufacturers demonstrated extreme operational capabilities, there remains a significant gap between the games and actual production scenarios.

Background / why this matters (Palimpsest synthesis, not part of the translation): The 'World Humanoid Robot Games' in Beijing are highlighting rapid advancements in robot speed and autonomy while underscoring remaining real-world application gaps.

Original Chinese: 机器人短跑超越人类极速 但短板依然明显 — 8月22日，“世界人形机器人运动会”在北京开幕，当天就有机器人跑出了比人类百米世界纪录更快的速度。此项赛事超过40%的项目要求机器人完全自主运行，而非后台遥控。尽管各厂商的机器人都展现出了极限工作能力，但是运动会和实际生产场景依然有不小的差距。

items.title: Investigated for adapting 'Red Songs', Guo Degang disappears from the stage in August
items.content_text:

Guo has been placed under investigation for adapting the lyrics of 'Red Songs' during a performance in July, and all his recent performances have been postponed.

Background / why this matters (Palimpsest synthesis, not part of the translation): Deutsche Welle reports that crosstalk performer Guo Degang is under investigation by Wuhan authorities and has halted performances following his adaptation of revolutionary song lyrics.
